assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE separate production-ready game UI sprite, NOT a mockup or sprite sheet. Image 1 is the approved MapleStory-inspired UI design: closely reproduce the specified part's warm chestnut wood, rounded chunky brown outlines, polished golden bevels and crisp hand-painted 2D cartoon finish. Output true transparent PNG outside the asset, with minimal 2% padding. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, characters, scenery, UI controls other than the single requested part. Straight front view, no perspective. High fidelity to reference, clean restrained shading; all usable interior areas blank.
Requested individual asset: Only the MAIN OUTER POPUP BOARD from image 1, landscape aspect 1400:900. Broad uninterrupted dark warm wood interior, thick rounded wood rim, thin bright gold inset border. Small vivid green leaves at top left, orange mushrooms with leaves at bottom left, cyan crystal cluster and leaves at bottom right. Do not include a header/title plaque, world cards, character cards, buttons, checkbox, scrollbar, close button, texts or inner panels. The board nearly fills the entire image.

Slim chunky golden beveled rim, dark brown outline, rounded clipped corners, tiny round golden fasteners. Interior is completely empty flat dark chocolate brown, later covered by an actual world photo. NO title plaque, leaves, rocks, scenic picture, badges or text. refinement.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this single game UI gold frame sprite. Keep the existing outer golden/brown rim, corner fasteners, exact overall wide shape and dimensions. Make the entire interior opening COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT (alpha=0), from the inner edges of the golden rim inward. Remove ALL dark brown interior fill, residual mottled blobs, gradients and translucency. This must be an empty window through which the game draws a photo. Outside the frame also stays truly transparent. ONLY the solid gold/brown rim and fasteners are opaque. No checkerboard baked in, no black or white fill, no scene, no text. Output one transparent PNG frame.
